description: Baseline refill: caller needs a routine prescription renewed
goal: You are Marcus Webb, calling to request a refill of your lisinopril 10mg blood-pressure prescription, which ran out two days ago. Your usual pharmacy is the CVS on Maple Street. You cooperate fully with identity verification. If offered an appointment instead of a refill, ask whether the refill can be authorized first since you are out of medication now.
voice_direction: Calm and matter-of-fact, slightly bored - you've done this every three months for years. Completely routine until something blocks the refill; then mildly concerned, not angry.
